title: A finite presentation model comparison isomorphism descends to a stage
statement: Let I be a directed preorder, F : I → CommRing a diagram with colimit A [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit], and i₀ ∈ I. Put A₀ = F(i₀). Let B₀, C₀ be commutative A₀-algebras and φ₀ : B₀ → C₀ a finitely presented A₀-algebra map [def-weil-pbc-finitely-presented-algebra]. Let P, Q be commutative rings with P finitely presented over Z and Q finitely presented over P. Equip B = A ⊗_{A₀} B₀ with a P-algebra structure, and suppose there is a ring isomorphism e : B ⊗_P Q ≅ A ⊗_{A₀} C₀ whose composite with B → B ⊗_P Q is id_A ⊗ φ₀. Then for some i ≥ i₀ there is a P-algebra structure on Bᵢ = F(i) ⊗_{A₀} B₀ and a ring isomorphism eᵢ : Bᵢ ⊗_P Q ≅ F(i) ⊗_{A₀} C₀ whose composite with Bᵢ → Bᵢ ⊗_P Q is id_{F(i)} ⊗ φ₀. No flatness assumption is made on P → Q.

source.place: Tag 02JO (3), proof of comparison-map descent; Tags 00QO and 05N9 (2), (3)

proof.text: Restrict to indices above i₀. The base-changed ring systems Bᵢ and Cᵢ have colimits B and C: the elementwise base-change result gives representatives and eventual vanishing; the module colimit criterion and directedness give the ring universal property. Tensor cancellation makes every Cᵢ finitely presented over Bᵢ, and makes later stages the base changes of earlier ones.

Factor P → B through Bᵢ since P is finitely presented over Z. Over this factorization, factor the map Q → C induced by e through some Cⱼ since Q is finitely presented over P. Construct Ψ : Bⱼ ⊗_P Q → Cⱼ on pure tensors from these maps. Its base change to B is e. Both algebras are finitely presented over Bⱼ. Descend e inverse by the map-factorization clause, then descend both inverse identities by the eventual-equality clause. At a common upper bound Ψ is a ring isomorphism; its composition with the left inclusion is the stage map by construction.

proof_origin.place: Stacks Project, Algebra, Tag 02JO; split of the existing stage-existence proof into a flat model and descent of its comparison isomorphism.
